subject: Recap + quick ask: Redwood fit for Luminari
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@luminari.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + quick ask: Redwood fit for Luminari

Hi Sam — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our 30m call and one small ask so we can prioritize on our side.

Key notes from call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for batch document embeddings and lower tail latency for query-time reranking.
- Current stack: managed embeddings service + homegrown reranker; pain points are cost variability and long cold-start tail latency during spikes.
- Success metric: 40% reduction in per-embedding cost or sub-150ms P95 for reranking at 8k tokens.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 in place; looking for platform with VPC and KMS integration.

Proposed next steps:
1) Pilot: 2-week pilot (dedicated pool) loading a sample of 200k docs; we'll provide an eval prompt set.
2) Tech sync: 45m session with your infra/ops to validate network/KMS requirements.
3) Pricing: draft pilot SOW + estimate for committed capacity.

Small ask: can you confirm (yes/no) whether a pilot is interesting for Luminari and the likely decision horizon (this quarter / next quarter / later)? That helps us scope the pilot and align a dedicated GPU slot.

I attached a short discovery deck with more detail and a rough pilot plan. If it helps, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/olga-p/redwood-30m — pick a slot for the tech sync and I’ll loop Marcus in.

Attachments: redwood-discovery-deck-luminari-20261001.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

If it’s helpful, two quick options that work for us:
- Pilot in Oct: we can start small (single-node reserved pool) and prove savings on a representative corpus.
- Pilot in Nov: full infra validation + KMS setup included.

If neither is feasible, a one-line "not a fit" helps us close the loop and avoid pinging you again. Otherwise, happy to schedule the infra sync — my calendar: https://calendly.com/olga-p/redwood-30m

Thanks —
Olga
